research_notes: The eventual Phase D should compare planned gap against actual idle gap and missed/overlap outcomes, not simply assume smaller is always better.
Close overshoot can consume part of planned gap, so a nominal +1m may already yield near-zero actual idle time.
Wake jitter can push the other direction and create longer gaps.
These empirical effects require a stable runtime policy first.
The current sample will contribute a predecessor close timestamp for future actual-gap calculation.
Successor actual start will complete that measurement retrospectively.
